name: Hopelend
fix_description: In cumulateToLiquidityIndex (called during flashloan repayment), the liquidityIndex update formula divides premium by totalSupply of hToken. When totalSupply is near zero (1 wei), a small flashloan fee causes the index to inflate by millions. Fix: enforce minimum totalSupply threshold before allowing flashloans, or mint dead shares on pool initialization so totalSupply never approaches zero.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit requires a fairly deep understanding of HopeLend’s liquidity index/accounting and a non-obvious rounding flaw, combined with a staged flash-loan-based setup, reserve manipulation, repeated internal flashloans, draining multiple assets, and then a custom deposit/withdraw loop to extract WBTC. The PoC is long and protocol-specific, with several moving parts and calculations that go well beyond a straightforward auditor write-up.
